reason: I already paid for a DM tool, got almost no replies and an action block, so anything that sends DMs for me makes me flinch. And $147 a month is a lot when I make about $31k a year and my real problem is probably my offer, not how my first message is written.
objection: I got an action block last time, and 'human pace' is just words. There are no customer results yet, so I'd be the guinea pig again. Even if the DMs are better, my bio link barely gets clicked, which tells me the problem is my offer or my content.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners at my size, with replies and booked calls, plus proof the preview DMs get replies from people like my prospects. A price under $60 would also let me try it without worrying.
